title: 第1764章 半个盛世第1763章 学我见色起意
content_zh:
千玑夫人反悔，云极有些始料不及。
早知如此，还不如自己去雷裂崖救人呢。
再不济也能把那群傻鸟忽悠瘸了。
可千玑夫人不好忽悠，读过书的妖王，很难骗得过人家。
尤其这位读过书的妖王见识了世家的财富之后，更不得了，望向女帝的目光仿佛要吃人似的。
千玑夫人的心思，云极很清楚。
无外乎更多的财富罢了。
沉吟稍许，云极刚要开口，楚天心先说话了。
“你想要多少。”
女帝的语气仍旧镇定，平静中不带半点波澜。
很难想象，
刚经历了雷裂崖的生死危机，又陷入千眼王蛇的爪牙之下，身为仙唐之主的楚天心还能如此冷静。
卸下女帝的身份，她不过是个二十岁的女孩子而已。
能有这份镇定，实属难得。
“仙唐女帝果然与凡人不同，够痛快，我要得不多，你肯定给得起……”
千玑夫人冷冷一笑，道：“半个盛世！”
千玑夫人的目标，不是什么如山的财宝也并非海量的灵石，她要的，是半个仙唐盛世！
这已经不算狮子大开口了，而是饕餮张口，鲸吞天下！
云极不由得再次皱了皱眉。
没想到千玑夫人的胃口如此之大，居然张口就要半个仙唐。

“朕若是不给呢。”楚天心冷声道。
“不用你给。”
千玑夫人淡然道：“只要本尊手里握着仙唐女帝，即可挟天子而令诸侯，细水长流，终有一日可以吞没半个仙唐盛世。”
云极听完一声长叹，
蹲在墙角，无奈的捂住了额头。
心说夫人呐，咱可别看兵书啦，看点霸总小说它不香么，你是不是这几百年都在看三国呢……
玩点战术就行了，你这都开始玩战略了……
云极现在基本能确定，
千玑夫人之前那个邻居先生，肯定是特么教兵法的！
倒是没学螳螂一族吃丈夫，人家学黄雀了。
螳螂捕蝉黄雀在后，毫不费力抓获女帝，渔翁得利。
楚天心默然不语，另只手死死捏成了拳头。
人家说得一点没错，
只要握住她这位仙唐女帝，除非仙唐改朝换代，有新皇登基，否则就得源源不断的流失资源。
能换皇帝吗？
答案是否定的。
除非楚天心死了，楚慎行才能顺利继位，只要楚天心活着一天，仙唐注定无主。
否则无论谁登基，都是谋反的名头。
到时候仙唐必定大乱，诸侯纷起，战火不断，民不聊生。
最好的解决办法，就是女帝身死万妖谷。

可是面对一位妖王，以楚天心金丹境的修为连死都做不到。
这是一盘必输的棋局。
即便是楚天心这种棋道高手，也看不出半点胜算。
根本无路可走，无处落子。
唯一的希望，只有云极。
content_en:
Mrs. Qianji went back on her word, which was a bit unexpected to Yunji.
If I had known this, I might as well have gone to Thunder Cliff to save people.
No matter how bad it is, you can fool those stupid birds into lameness.
But Mrs. Qianji is not easy to fool, and it is difficult for the demon king who has read books to deceive others.
Especially after the demon king, who had read books, saw the wealth of the family, it was even worse. He looked at the empress as if he wanted to eat someone.
Yunji knew Mrs. Qianji’s thoughts very well.
Nothing more than more wealth.
After pondering for a while, Yunji was about to speak, but Chu Tianxin spoke first.
"As many as you want."
The empress's tone remained calm, without any ripples in her calmness.
It's hard to imagine,
Having just experienced the life-and-death crisis at Thunder Cliff, and then falling into the claws of the Thousand-Eyed King Snake, Chu Tianxin, as the Lord of Immortal Tang, could still be so calm.
Without the identity of the empress, she is just a twenty-year-old girl.
It is rare to have such calmness.
"The Empress of the Immortal Tang Dynasty is indeed different from ordinary people. She is happy enough. I don't want much, so you can definitely afford it..."
Mrs. Qianji smiled coldly and said: "Half a prosperous age!"
Madam Qianji’s goal is not a mountain of treasure or a vast amount of spiritual stones. What she wants is half of the prosperous Tang Dynasty!
This is no longer a lion opening its mouth, but a glutton opening its mouth and swallowing the world!
Yunji couldn't help but frowned again.
I didn't expect that Mrs. Qianji's appetite was so big that she would even open her mouth and ask for half of the Immortal Tang.
"What if I don't give it to you?" Chu Tianxin said coldly.
"You don't need to give it."
Mrs. Qianji said calmly: "As long as I hold the Empress of the Immortal Tang Dynasty in my hand, I can hold the emperor and command the princes. The long flow of water will eventually swallow up half of the prosperous age of the Immortal Tang Dynasty."
Yunji let out a long sigh after hearing this,
He squatted in the corner and covered his forehead helplessly.
I said to you, madam, let’s not read the book of war. Wouldn’t it be delicious to read some of Ba Zong’s novels? Have you been reading the Three Kingdoms for hundreds of years...
Just play some tactics, now you are starting to play strategy...
Yunji is now basically certain,
The neighbor before Mrs. Qianji must have taught the art of war!
Rather than imitating the mantis family in eating their husbands, they imitate the oriole.
The mantis catches the cicada and the oriole follows, and captures the empress effortlessly, and the fisherman gains a profit.
Chu Tianxin remained silent and clenched his other hand into a fist.
What they said is absolutely correct.
As long as she, the Empress of the Immortal Tang Dynasty, is held, unless the Immortal Tang Dynasty changes and a new emperor ascends the throne, resources will continue to be lost.
Can I change the emperor?
The answer is no.
Unless Chu Tianxin dies, Chu Shenxing can successfully succeed to the throne. As long as Chu Tianxin lives for one day, Xiantang is destined to have no owner.
Otherwise, whoever ascends the throne will be accused of treason.
At that time, the Immortal Tang Dynasty will definitely be in chaos, the princes will rise one after another, the war will continue, and the people will be in dire straits.
The best solution is for the empress to die in the Valley of Ten Thousand Demons.
But facing a demon king, Chu Tianxin's cultivation level in the golden elixir realm would not even allow him to die.
This is a losing game.
Even a chess master like Chu Tianxin has no chance of winning.
There is no way to go, no place to move.
The only hope is Yunji.
